title: wkcv OpenCV Tools — T2 Howto
desc: Implementation spec: module architecture, API contracts, Python dependencies, binary thresholds, area filtering, output formats (JSON/CSV/text).
steps: ## Module Architecture
Four independent Python modules + PowerShell launcher (wkcv.ps1).
- wkcv_gaps.py: PIL + numpy, OCR via wkappbot ocr, a11y via wkappbot a11y find.
- wkcv_findtext.py: pytesseract (Tesseract), Pillow.
- wkcv_segment.py: opencv-python (cv2), numpy. Contour detection or connected components.
- wkcv_room.py: opencv-python (cv2), camera feed analysis.
## wkcv_segment.py API
def segment_image(image_path, threshold=127, min_area=100, max_area=None, method='contour')
Returns: List[Dict] with {id, bbox: {x,y,w,h}, area, center: {x,y}}
threshold: binary threshold (0-255); default 127.
min_area: skip contours smaller than this (pixels); default 100.
max_area: skip contours larger than this; None = no limit.
method: 'contour' (find contours) or 'component' (connected components).
## Output Formats
Text (default): Human-readable list with region info.
JSON (--json): One object per line: {id, bbox, area, center}.
CSV (--csv): Header + rows: id,x,y,w,h,area,cx,cy.
## Exit Codes
0: Success (results found).
1: Error (image not found, processing failed).
2: No results (image valid but no regions/text/detections).
3: Python module error (missing dependency, runtime error).
## Binary Threshold Strategy
Default 127 works for most images; adjust --threshold for dark/bright images.
Use lower thresholds (50-100) for bright images, higher (150-200) for dark.
## Contour Method vs Connected Components
--method contour: Find external outlines of objects (faster, outline-focused).
--method component: Label all connected pixel groups (more granular, all groups).
## Size Filtering
min_area (default 100): Skip very small noise regions.
max_area (optional): Skip large regions (e.g., background).
Example: --min-area 500 --max-area 50000 filters to mid-size objects.
